activity.notes: Ashikaga Takauji received the title of shogun in 1338 and founded the Ashikaga/Muromachi shogunate. He remained the first Ashikaga shogun until his death in 1358. ATLAS follows the existing shogun modeling used for Minamoto no Yoritomo by binding the office to the canonical Japan polity rather than creating a duplicate shogunate polity solely for the officeholder.
